safe_non_enabling_governance_clarificati.purpose: Make the current fail-closed boundary explicit without creating a base case.
safe_non_enabling_governance_clarificati.text: No positive internal-family certificate may be issued solely because the available data has reached its finest resolution, subdivisions are not visible, recursion depth is exhausted, direct-child cardinality matches, or a caller supplies family, completion, or position labels. Until separately approved protected authority defines a deterministic terminal primitive and applicable completion requirements, any branch that cannot complete required internal-family validation remains INTERNALS_UNRESOLVED.

methodology_risk: Any enabling project policy presently available would add substantive Elliott validity not supported by the approved corpus or would weaken the current exact-family proof claim.
replacement_path: If new approved source authority later defines a terminal primitive and completion semantics, replace the non-enabling clarification through a separately reviewed minimal Brain amendment and retain the historical proposal record.
